diagrams.title: Before: one regional runtime
diagrams.description: Existing runtime, governed model lineage and trusted policy live in one logical regional deployment.

diagrams.title: After: regional cells with an EU authority quorum
diagrams.description: Ingress sends Tenant C to its US-home cell and A/B to the EU. An EU-only 2-of-3 authority quorum grants the writer lease. EU-primary replicates asynchronously to EU-secondary. On primary loss the promotion gate either passes every check or fails closed.
nodes: Authenticate, place and scope the tenant

side: Tenant C only, with its own authority

nodes: Policy, approvals and lease on a 2-of-3 EU quorum
A/B writer holding the current epoch
New lease, old epoch rejected, policy, bundle, capacity

side: Quorum lost or a check failed

diagrams.title: Recovery sequence: control plane, then data plane
diagrams.description: The incident controller detects, places, fences and restores without talking to the client. Alice's request then passes ingress authentication, tenant scope and placement before admission and reconciliation. Failed prerequisites stop promotion.

side: No lease: fail closed, authority unavailable

lab_assumptions: Toy policy: A/B allowed in EU only, RPO 60 seconds, RTO 600 seconds. The plan is detection 60 + fencing 30 + restore + route 30 + validation 60 seconds. Policy, approval, audit and bundle gates are assumed true here; Python tests exercise them. Results are computed from assumptions, not measured.
